purpose: Drives the reproduction dry runs: a REPRODUCED attempt, a NOT_REPRODUCED attempt (the finding and the report remain valid open evidence), and an attempt on a successor artifact that moves nothing without a recorded applicability relationship. Tests fill sourceReport with the scratch intake id.

reproduced.hypothesis: constructed fixture: the freeze follows the settings panel grab
reproduced.method: constructed fixture: scripted panel open/close x20 while the character animates

notReproduced.hypothesis: constructed fixture: flicker reproduces on panel open
notReproduced.method: constructed fixture: panel open/close x50, frame capture compared
notReproduced.limitations: constructed fixture: tester hardware GPU not matched; VM uses llvmpipe

successorAttempt.hypothesis: constructed fixture: the freeze persists on the successor build
successorAttempt.method: constructed fixture: same scripted panel exercise
